jonathan: Heads-up — release pipeline is blocked by a regen diff from typegen. Sample app tests are failing in CI after the OpenAPI re-gen; looks like enum ordering and one param went from optional -> required. publish job tripped semver-guard.
ci-bot: release-checks › regendiff (/workflows/release) failed
ci-bot: Reason: changelog vs diff mismatch: detected non-backwards-compatible change but changelog labels only include 'patch'.
jonathan: Paste of the failure log: ```
Regendiff summary:
- enum `deployment_mode` reordered (old: [auto,manual], new: [manual,auto])
- endpoint /jobs create: param `timeout` became required
Result: breaking-change + non-doc update
```
maria: Ack. I ran locally — the enum reorder is from a generator sorting tweak (non-functional), but `timeout` required is real (we changed schema). Can we treat the enum reorder as noise and only surface the required param as the change? Semver-guard is flagging both and forcing a minor/breaking label.
kevin: We can suppress the enum reorder by adding the new sort flag to typegen: `--stable-enum-order` (I have a quick patch). For the required param, do we intend to make it required at API level? If not, revert the OpenAPI tweak.
sara: The Python sampleapp test is failing because it calls create_job without timeout. Quick repro: `python sampleapp create_job()` -> 400. That suggests downstream code assumes default optional. If we are making it required we need to update SDKs and changelogs.
oliver: Proposal: two-step fix — (1) revert the required bit in OpenAPI and re-run typegen to get a clean regen diff, (2) follow up separately to intentionally add the required param with an explicit changelog entry and semver bump. Which is easier for release schedule?
jonathan: We need a hotfix to unblock the publish. Reverting the schema is fine for now. Can someone open a small PR with: revert schema line, regenerate typegen artifacts, and update the changelog to match (patch). If we do that we keep semver as patch and unblock.
kevin: I'll open the PR. Diff will be small. Commands I ran locally: ```bash
git checkout -b fix/typegen-enum-noise-regen
# revert schema change
make regen-typegen
# run tests
./scripts/ci/local-run-tests.sh sampleapp
```
ci-bot: Note: when PR lands, release pipeline will re-run regendiff and semver-guard. Make sure changelog contains exactly one entry under "Patch" or CI will still fail.
maria: Also adding: please add a one-line note in changelog: "docs: revert accidental schema change; no functional API change" so the regendiff checker treats it as patch.
sara: Thanks — once PR is up I'll re-run failing sampleapp test locally and sign off. :thumbsup:
jonathan: Great. Assigning to kevin. Kevin, please cc me and @maria in the PR so we can fast-track merge and trigger a release re-run.
kevin: On it, will ping when CI green.
